notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11464454/1cf537c56bf3a83530037f8e35ce3666ee9a350d.jpg[/img]

A new patch for We are the Plague on Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

PATCH NOTE:
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!
- Check out the new snazzy summary screen with convenient improvements.
- Added some minor bug fixes


https://steamcommunity.com/app/992690/discussions/0/1652171126139342037/

notes.title: Quick update
notes.notes:
- Accidental "ready" lock removed 
- Proper character is always displayed during the first round
- Strange death in the beginning of new round problem fixed 
- Some connecting/disconnecting of the players behaviours improved
- Long awaited "reset skill" button added
- Be quick: if you do not press "ready" in 15 seconds, when others did, you will be kicked out the lobby
- A new achievement arrived - Score Master "Let yourself be killed by branch with score 180 points exactly"

notes.title: Patch nr "4 players multiplayer"
notes.notes:
Long-awaited multiplayer "timbermill mode" has landed, and maximum number of players has been doubled! 

Since this day tremendous number of four players can compete in chopping wood in one time!

Available in split screen as well as in on-line multiplayer game.

Please join others in this wood massacre!

Also new in version 1.2:

- 2 new achievements
- "Unlock new character" notifications
- Some minor improvements

notes.title: First update!
notes.notes:
What's new:

- More accurate matchmaking.
- Three new achievements plus fixed older one.
- Now you can change your character in online multiplayer mode.
- Double points for ultrafast chopping bug fixed.
- Unlocking character by moving it from split screen mode bug removed.
- Rank display refreshing during multiplayer improved.
- A couple important sfx added including online opponent appearing alarm.
- Now in multiplayer music plays faster during a round.
- Unnecessary music reset removed.
- Even more realistic chop sound (it was "chop" now is "choop" and in 5.1 surround:-)
- Photorealistic beards! :-)
